findings.evidence: `privilege/privileges/ldap/sasl.go:66` reads `impl.saslAuthMethod` after releasing the config lock (`privilege/privileges/ldap/sasl.go:40`), while writes happen under `impl.Lock()` in `privilege/privileges/ldap/sasl.go:100`. The value is updated from sysvars (`sessionctx/variable/sysvar.go:2522`). Sysvar-cache rebuild also invokes `SetGlobal` hooks for all global sysvars (`domain/sysvar_cache.go:128`), increasing the chance of concurrent writes during logins.
findings.fix: Capture the SASL method into a local variable while holding the existing RLock and use the local copy in the auth loop (e.g. grab `method := impl.saslAuthMethod` inside the closure and pass `method` to `ServerBindStep`). Optionally make `SetSASLAuthMethod` skip assignment when unchanged to avoid extra writes during sysvar-cache rebuilds.
findings.impact: Concurrent `SET GLOBAL` / sysvar-cache rebuild can race with LDAP SASL authentication, causing undefined behavior (possible crash/panic due to Go data race), intermittent login failures, or inconsistent SASL mechanism use. This can manifest as a denial-of-service risk if sysvars are updated while LDAP SASL logins are in progress.
findings.verify: Add a targeted concurrency test that runs `ldap.LDAPSASLAuthImpl.AuthLDAPSASL(...)` while concurrently changing `authentication_ldap_sasl_auth_method_name` via `SET GLOBAL` (or triggering sysvar cache rebuild), then validate under `go test -race` for the LDAP auth / server auth path.
findings.what: LDAP SASL auth method (`saslAuthMethod`) is read without synchronization during authentication, but written under lock via sysvar updates; this is a data race.

subject: privilege, server: support LDAP authentication (#43582)
summary: Adds LDAP authentication support (simple bind and SASL) with new authentication plugin constants, new LDAP sysvars, protocol auth-switch handling in `server/conn.go`, and LDAP verification paths in `privilege/privileges`. Most changes are localized to connection authentication and user DDL validation; one concurrency bug remains in LDAP SASL method handling.
